description: ERC-20 approvals a wallet has granted (what it approved and for how much) across many of the 23 EVM chains in ONE call — including young chains (Robinhood, Plasma, Ink) that revoke.cash-style tools skip. Scans Approval logs, reads the live allowance, drops revoked ones, flags unlimited approvals. Heavy: needs NODEFLARE_API_KEY or X402_PRIVATE_KEY.
